text:
maria_sales: FYI Acme wants to move off CompetitorX and do a short POC next week. Main asks: API parity, pricing delta, and an enterprise security questionnaire.

sam_eng: Great — do we have a list of their top 3 endpoints they use? (generation/embeddings/rerank?)

maria_sales: They use "generate" heavily and embeddings for search. Also some custom reranking flow.

jordan_se: For generate parity, we should surface prompt mapping differences and a shim plan. CompetitorX injects a system prefix; Redwood doesn't by default.

lexi_solutions: Proposal: create a tiny compatibility shim that rewrites requests: add system prompt, normalizes stop tokens, and maps deprecated params. Can be deployed as a per-tenant proxy during the POC.

sam_eng: Sounds good. Two engineering notes: 1) KV-cache keys need to be aligned if they do streaming+prefix caching, 2) we should pin model variant to avoid nondeterministic drift during parity tests.

maria_sales: Customer asked about sample rate-limited pricing vs flat commit. They have bursty spikes — wants to understand cost predictability.

jordan_se: Offer: short-term POC priced as usage + a small weekly reserve to cover spikes. If they convert to Dedicated, we'll propose commit tiers.

chen_security: I started the security questionnaire. They asked for SOC2, SSO (SAML), and support for customer-managed KMS for Private. We can provide SOC2 report and SSO docs; Private supports KMS but need to check HSM options.

maria_sales: Can you flag any blockers for the POC timeline (7 days)?

chen_security: Two potential blockers: 1) Their legal wants an indemnity tweak (enterprise term) — legal will need ~5 biz days. 2) If they insist on HSM-backed key storage for the POC, that's not standard for hosted — would need Private setup which is heavier.

lexi_solutions: For parity testing we should run a small eval harness: send their representative prompts through CompetitorX and Redwood with the shim, capture outputs, and run automated diff metrics (BLEU/embedding-sim). I can spin this up and send the report mid-week.

sam_eng: Add a deterministic seed and temperature mapping to reduce variance. Also record latency P95 and token costs per request for their sample traffic.

maria_sales: Customer also wants to confirm webhooks and streaming behavior match. Any known response-drift issues?

jordan_se: CompetitorX truncates long outputs differently (they prefer last-token truncation). We should emulate that in the shim or note in the acceptance criteria. Also some of their prompts rely on model-specific stop token quirks.

deploy_bot: deploy status: created sandbox proxy "acme-compat-shim" on staging, image: rw/compat-shim:v0.1.

lexi_solutions: Nice — once staging proxy is up I'll route sample traffic. maria, can you get an exported corpus of 200 canonical prompts from the customer?

maria_sales: I'll request it today. They said they can export CSV by EOD.

chen_security: For the questionnaire I need their inventory of data flows. If they process PII in prompts, we need to verify retention policy and masking. Can you ask them to flag any PII examples before sending corpus?

maria_sales: Will do. I'll send a short checklist to the POC contact.

sam_eng: Heads-up: If we emulate their exact streaming boundaries, CPU cost increases slightly on the shim. I'll add an estimate to the cost note.

jordan_se: Also test edge cases: multi-turn prompt reshaping, and tokens per call when they use incremental context windows.

maria_sales: Goal: proof of functional parity + performance snapshot in 5 business days, commercial terms to follow in week 2. Anyone see a showstopper?

chen_security: Not a showstopper, but legal + HSM requests could delay conversion. Recommend we scope POC to hosted with SAML + exported logs, call out HSM as an enterprise migration path.

lexi_solutions: I'll prepare a short acceptance criteria doc: prompt parity thresholds, latency SLOs, and rollback plan if mismatch.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll update the customer and block calendar for kick-off Monday. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
